Projects.name: Mycro 1
Projects.description: Mycro provides a centralized platform for capturing, sharing, and recognizing demos with rich context. It enables creators to submit demos easily, teams to browse and vote on standout work, and stakeholders to reuse real proof points for storytelling and alignment, turning visibility into momentum and learning across the organization.

Deliverables.title: Community Voting & Recognition Experience
Deliverables.description: Supports anonymous voting and leaderboards to recognize standout demos.

Deliverables.title: Admin Governance & Moderation Experience
Deliverables.description: Provides operational controls for content moderation and contest/voting rules.

Deliverables.title: External Sharing Experience
Deliverables.description: Enables demos to be shared externally for storytelling and enablement.

Deliverables.title: Submit & Publish Demo
Deliverables.description: End-to-end flow for submitting, validating, previewing, and publishing a demo.

Deliverables.title: Browse, Vote & Recognize Demos
Deliverables.description: Flow for discovering demos, voting anonymously, and viewing recognition results.

Deliverables.title: External Video Platforms
Deliverables.description: Third-party video hosting providers such as Loom and YouTube.

Deliverables.title: Project Operations
Deliverables.description: Project-wide management activities and cross-cutting tasks

Deliverables.title: Demo Discovery & Viewing Experience
Deliverables.description: Allows users to browse, open, and view demos from a central feed.

Deliverables.title: Demo Submission Experience
Deliverables.description: Enables creators to submit, preview, and manage demos with rich context.
